Module media.barney.contract.spring.boot.starter

Package media.barney.contract.spring

@NullMarked package media.barney.contract.spring
Spring Boot auto-configuration and configuration properties for optional contract-java integrations.

This package contains the starter's supported Boot-facing API; integrations remain conditional and configurable.

The starter does not add proxy-based or reflection-based contract enforcement. Contract checks are still generated by contract-core. The Boot integrations provide conditional actuator information and an opt-in servlet exception resolver for contract-java runtime bridge violations.
